reviews.title: Bluetooth connection issue
reviews.text:
I am unable to connect my Zikr Ring Noor to Bluetooth. The ring does not appear in my iPhone Bluetooth list, and it also does not appear when searching from inside the iQIBLA Life app.

I have tried charging the ring, restarting my phone, resetting the ring, checking Bluetooth permissions, reinstalling the app, and searching several times, but the device still cannot be detected. The frustrating part is that it was connected earlier and worked for only about one week before this issue started.

Clearer troubleshooting steps and better support inside the app are needed, especially for users who cannot detect or reconnect their ring.

I would appreciate your immediate support in resolving this issue.

reviews.title: I like it but it doesn’t quite work
reviews.text: I’ve had the device and app I believe for a few months.  It’s great, as it motivates me to continue dhikr throughout the day.  However, over this period, the device regularly resets itself, the app logs me out for some random reason and lastly the device charging port has stopped working.  I don’t understand why you’d go for a non-standard usb charger.  Anyways, I like the device but I can’t use it any longer.  I did order a replacement, the newer Joud version.  That ended up not charging either.

reviews.title: Needs help
reviews.text: I hate to write a bad review and that to especially for an app that is supposed to help you with your spiritual actions, however I can’t be the only one that finds the ui/ux experience frustrating.  I gave this app one star because 1 out of three times the app connects to the device successfully.  Now let’s get to what could make this app many folds better.  When I connect the device, please don’t reset my counter.  When you reset my counter my tracking for that day is off.  When I track custom tasbeeh, why can I not see the zikr I did on that day, just number and the word custom is shown.  When I have custom zikr that I do daily, do I really have to select the count again? Also when I am doing custom zikr vs tasbeeh, can I not switch between each custom zikr and tasbeeh so I can mix up my zikr actions, now I have to complete one count before I can switch.  Also you guys need to add competition mode.  So I can have a friendly reminder to my brother in islam to get his zikr on, it’s called gamification.  Please save my settings, between app updates and device getting disconnected and reconnected, save my score and settings.  Please stop resetting, put a warning on screen, like “seems you have done some zikr today, would you like to continue, or add it to a zikr of your choosing”.  So many opportunities for greatness.  Imagine the benefit to the millions that have bought this device.  Asalamoalaikum
